reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Washington
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law require landlords to describe repercussions for failure to cure
    when giving tenants notice to vacate the property?
*/

% -------------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -------------------------------

scenario_state(washington).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question concerns a landlord giving a notice to vacate.
% The provided statute is specifically about the 14-day "pay rent or vacate" notice.
scenario_notice_served(landlord1, tenant1, fourteen_day_pay_rent_or_vacate).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario described by the question is present. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(washington),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_notice_served(_Landlord, _Tenant, fourteen_day_pay_rent_or_vacate).

% -------------------------------
% Statute translation (RCW 59.18.057 (2021))
% -------------------------------

/*
  RCW 59.18.057(1) (2021): Every 14-day notice served pursuant to RCW 59.12.030(3)
  must be in substantially the specified form.

  The statutory form includes (among other text) the warning:
  "Any failure to comply with this notice within fourteen (14) days after service of this notice
   may result in a judicial proceeding that leads to your eviction from the premises."

  We model that as a required element of the 14-day pay-or-vacate notice.
*/

% statute_applicable(State, Year, StatuteId).
statute_applicable(washington, 2021, rcw_59_18_057).

% notice_type_covered_by_statute(State, Year, StatuteId, NoticeType).
notice_type_covered_by_statute(washington, 2021, rcw_59_18_057, fourteen_day_pay_rent_or_vacate).

% required_notice_element(State, Year, NoticeType, Element).
% Element = warning_about_consequences_for_noncompliance describes repercussions for failure to cure.
required_notice_element(washington, 2021, fourteen_day_pay_rent_or_vacate, warning_about_consequences_for_noncompliance) :-
    statute_applicable(washington, 2021, rcw_59_18_057),
    notice_type_covered_by_statute(washington, 2021, rcw_59_18_057, fourteen_day_pay_rent_or_vacate).

/*
  Legal conclusion helper:
  The law "requires landlords to describe repercussions for failure to cure"
  if the applicable notice form must include a warning about consequences of noncompliance.
*/
law_requires_repercussions_description(State, Year, NoticeType) :-
    required_notice_element(State, Year, NoticeType, warning_about_consequences_for_noncompliance).

% -------------------------------
% Reasoning to answer the question
% -------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_notice_served(_Landlord, _Tenant, NoticeType),
    law_requires_repercussions_description(State, Year, NoticeType),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -------------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require landlords to describe repercussions for failure to cure when giving tenants notice to vacate the property?
